Why is the `href` in your example https://www.algolia.com/users/sign\_in instead of the link you want to go to? e.g. if the url you put in Algolia are complete urls, then do:

```
<a href="{{href}}">
```

or whatever the name of the attribute is. If the URL is relative, then:

```
<a href="https://base.com/{{path}}">
```

Is that what you meant?
